title: The cat who was mayor for 20 years
titulo: A CAT WAS MAYOR FOR 20 YEARS
estilo_visual: fotografías de dominio público o licencia libre

sources.cita_corta: AP News, 23-jul-2017: He was purrfect: Honorary cat mayor in Alaska town dies.
Alaska Public Media, 24-jul-2017: 'Mayor' Stubbs the Cat passes away at 20.
CNN, 23-jul-2017: Honorary mayor, Stubbs the Cat, dies at 20.

scenes.narration: A town in Alaska had the same mayor for about twenty years. He never raised taxes, never gave a speech, and he didn't have a tail.
scenes.image_credit: Mayor Stubbs. Jenni Konrad, CC BY-SA 2.0. Wikimedia Commons: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Mayor_Stubbs.jpg

scenes.narration: Talkeetna is a tiny town north of Anchorage, at the foot of the mountains. It isn't incorporated, so officially it has no mayor. Someone with whiskers was going to fill that gap.
scenes.image_credit: Talkeetna June 2015. Kolmkolm, CC BY-SA 4.0. Wikimedia Commons: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Talkeetna_June_2015.JPG

scenes.narration: In 1997 the candidate arrived: a tailless cat named Stubbs, as in stub. According to CNN, locals made him honorary mayor as a write-in, for lack of convincing human candidates. And the title stuck.
scenes.image_credit: Nagley's Store, Talkeetna, AK. Zeete, CC BY-SA 4.0. Wikimedia Commons: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Nagley%27s_Store,_Talkeetna,_AK.jpg

scenes.narration: His office was Nagley's store and the pub next door, the West Rib. His schedule: naps, tourists and head scratches. The store owners said people asked about a hundred times a day where the mayor was.
scenes.image_credit: The inside of Nagley's Store on Main Street in Talkeetna. Will Koeppen, CC BY-SA 4.0. Wikimedia Commons: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:The_inside_of_Nagley%27s_Store_on_Main_Street_in_Talkeetna.jpg

capa.etiqueta: times a day: where's the mayor?

scenes.narration: Over the years he slowed down and rarely visited the store. In 2016 a kitten named Denali arrived, his future successor. And in July 2017, the AP reported, Stubbs died at twenty. In his sleep. His owners wrote that he was a trouper until the very last day of his life.
scenes.image_credit: Nagley's General Store at Night, Winter, Talkeetna, Alaska. Laura Alier, CC BY 4.0. Wikimedia Commons: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Nagley%27s_General_Store_at_Night,_Winter,_Talkeetna,_Alaska.jpg

scenes.narration: Twenty years in office, and his only campaign promise was the nap. Few human politicians last that long, and almost none with so many naps. Would you vote for a cat?
scenes.image_credit: Mayor Stubbs. Jenni Konrad, CC BY-SA 2.0. Wikimedia Commons: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Mayor_Stubbs.jpg
